text: When my hours were cut at work I couldn't keep up with the rent. I fell behind, got evicted, and ended up sleeping rough. Months on the street have left me ill most of the time.
After the plant closed I lost my income and the rent piled up. The landlord evicted me, and I have been homeless ever since; my health has fallen apart out here.
A sudden illness stopped me working and I couldn't pay the rent. I was evicted within weeks, ended up on the streets, and my body has been breaking down ever since.

When my car broke down I suddenly couldn't cover both the repairs and the rent, and I fell behind for a couple of months. It was tight and stressful, but I caught up before it went any further and kept my flat.
Losing my job meant I couldn't make rent, and after a few missed payments I was evicted. I have been homeless since, sleeping in a shelter when I can get a bed.
A messy divorce left me unable to afford the flat on my own. I got behind, was evicted, and ended up on the street, where my health has steadily got worse.
I had a real scare when a big medical bill landed, and for a while I panicked about money. In the end I tightened everything up and never actually fell behind on the rent.
When my benefits were delayed the money ran out and I couldn't pay rent. The eviction came fast, I ended up homeless, and living outside has wrecked my health.
After I was laid off I quickly fell behind on rent and thought I'd lose the flat. But my sister stepped in and covered a couple of months, so the eviction never happened and I stayed housed.
When my shifts dried up I couldn't make rent, and the landlord had me out within a couple of months. I have been homeless since, staying at a hostel.
